title: Devices
description: Find, set up and look after the stations and equipment around you.
summary: One list of every machine around you. A board on a USB cable gets XPRS installed and is made yours (a phone needs a USB OTG adapter). Stations on your WiFi or near you over Bluetooth are listed with what they run and how they are doing. A station you own can be changed from here, in the room or from anywhere on the internet: its WiFi, name, callsign, settings and firmware. That includes a Linux server or a phone left at home as a station. Cameras, doorbells, sensors and plugs are listed too, each with the screen that fits it. A doorbell camera offers a picture and a live view, and can tell you when somebody rings.
